title: an icon drawn by reference into an external sprite renders on both halves

interactions.name: the sprite's star is materialized in the mirror

notes: the star's absence plane-side is invisible to the DOM probes — the <use> box is the same size empty or full — so the pin is the materialized symbol itself: the agent fetches the sprite, ships the fragment on the use element, and the patcher builds it into the mirror's own sprite holder
